description: Test suite for the WebModuleUtil class in the OpenMRS project, focusing on module startup, servlet loading, and web folder retrieval.

classes.name: WebModuleUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for WebModuleUtil utility functions in the OpenMRS web module.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up loaded modules after each test.

methods.name: isModulePackageNameInTaskClass_shouldReturnFalseForDifferentPackageName
methods.description: Tests the package name matching logic when packages are different.

methods.name: isModulePackageNameInTaskClass_shouldReturnFalseIfModuleHasLongerPackageName
methods.description: Tests the package matcher when the module package is longer.

methods.name: isModulePackageNameInTaskClass_shouldProperlyMatchSubpackages
methods.description: Verifies matching of subpackages within module package names.

methods.name: isModulePackageNameInTaskClass_shouldReturnFalseForEmptyPackageNames
methods.description: Ensures the package matcher returns false for empty strings.

methods.name: startModule_shouldCreateDwrModulesXmlIfNotExists
methods.description: Tests creation of dwr-modules.xml when starting a module.

methods.name: startModule_dwrModuleXmlshouldContainModuleInfo
methods.description: Verifies that the dwr-modules.xml content includes the module ID after startup.

methods.name: loadServlets_AddsServletsWithoutInitParams
methods.description: Tests loading servlets without any initialization parameters.

methods.name: loadServlets_AddsCorrectInitParamsToConfig
methods.description: Tests correct setting of servlet init parameters during loading.

methods.name: buildModuleForMessageTest
methods.description: Helper method to create a module with messages and configuration.

methods.name: buildModuleConfig
methods.description: Constructs a simple XML configuration document for a module.

methods.name: buildModuleConfigWithServlets
methods.description: Builds a module configuration XML with embedded servlet definitions.

methods.name: getModuleWebFolder_shouldReturnNullIfTheDispatcherServletIsNotYetSet
methods.description: Tests that getModuleWebFolder throws an exception if the Servlet is not initialized.

methods.name: getModuleWebFolder_shouldReturnTheCorrectModuleFolder
methods.description: Verifies correct path computation for module web folder without trailing slash.

methods.name: getModuleWebFolder_shouldReturnTheCorrectModuleFolderIfRealPathHasATrailingSlash
methods.description: Verifies correct path computation for module web folder with trailing slash.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Helper method to set up mocks for servlet context and dispatcher.
